review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native Thai review (preferably a Chiang Mai speaker; the text is spoken-standard Central Thai). Speakers: shepherd=The shepherd (man; ผม). For the reviewer - a plain retelling for learners, written for the course; it quotes neither the OTCV nor THSV11 and is not a translation of Luke 15. Needs a Scripture-competent reviewer as well as a linguistic one: check that "ยินดี" and the neighbours' joy read naturally, that the wording does not claim more than the parable, and that no Thai Bible phrase has been copied by accident. The narration has no particles; the shepherd's speech says ผม without ครับ.
